column1: # Every piece in the design's own 2D cutting file, measured: the reference for
# this tool's bill of materials and panel development on an imported design.
# SOURCE: "20260829 Swoop2 2D.dxf" in the design archive "20260829 Swoop2.zip", laboratoridenvol.com/projects/Swoop2/Swoop2.en.html
#   Retrieved 2026-10-21. Laboratori d'envol publishes its designs and the
#   program that draws them (LEparagliding, GNU GPL) at laboratoridenvol.com.
# METHOD: the frames "for cutting table" and the internal-structure frames of
#   the 2D DXF. A piece is a closed outline at its CUT size: the seam allowance
#   (10 mm on panels and ribs, 10 mm leading edge, 20 mm trailing edge; its section 6) is part of the outline. Holes are the closed loops inside a
#   piece and are taken out. The upper surface's tip piece is drawn 1.4 cm open and is counted (778.72 cm2 of the colour-panel total, 1698.80 of the undivided).
#   Each undivided panel is also listed by itself, by its cell (in the rib column),
#   in the order the file draws them: from the centre out. The tip's upper panel,
#   And each piece sewn inside the wing (section 12) by itself, added
#   2026-10-22: every full diagonal by the rib its lines hang from and the
#   side it runs to; every strap by its row and inboard rib; every piece
#   between two ribs by its inboard rib and chord position; every rod pocket
#   by its rib and its rod's bloc (section 21). Which piece is
#   which is read off where the program lays it out — across the frame by
#   rib, along it by row or chord position — and each was confirmed against
#   the piece the program's own construction gives (docs/internal-structure.md).
#   A diagonal's gross area is its outline, its cut-outs between anchors
#   taken out of it; its holes are the ellipses at its anchors. The rib-23
#   diagonal has two: the program computes three, and the file leaves out
#   the one that runs off the piece.
#   One side of the wing: the whole wing is twice this, the centre rib once.
#   Units: the file's own, centimetres; areas cm2.

# CHECKS: rib 1 is its section's area (gnuReflex, 0.11161 c2) plus 10 mm over its contour, 5312 cm2 against 5313.92; its holes are its section 4, 1186 cm2 against 1183.76; the upper surface is the program's own 3D surface (STL, 21.67 m2 whole wing) plus seam allowance.
